why: This is exactly LeetCode 25, Reverse Nodes in k-Group. The two-pointer part of the week is the probe: walk k steps ahead to confirm a full group exists, then reverse the group in place and stitch it between the previous group's tail and the next group's head.
hints: Before reversing, check that k nodes actually remain; a short tail is left alone.
Reverse a group with the standard prev/cur loop, but start prev at the node after the group so the reversed group is already connected to the rest.
Keep prevTail (the last node of the finished part) and the group's old first node, which becomes its new tail. Each node is visited twice: O(n) time, O(1) extra space.
pitfalls: k = 1 returns the list unchanged; k = n reverses everything.
After a reversal, the old first node of the group is the new tail; that is where the next group attaches.
